text:
Alex: Heads-up — I'm building the inbound routing matrix + webinar hook for the benchmark release next Tue. Need to lock segment rules, subject lines, and who gets the webinar invite vs. the digest. :calendar:
Maya: love it. can we make webinar invite the primary CTA for enterprise and trial accounts, digest for small teams?
CJ: +1. also: map by company_size and recent_api_calls. if api_calls > 500 in last 7d -> webinar invite.
Zara: for newsletter subscribers who've never used the API, do a 3-email nurture: 0) benchmark highlights, 1) product deep-dive + demo clip, 2) webinar invite (last chance). spacing: 3 days.
Sam: deliverability flag — stagger sends across regions to avoid ISP throttling. US west 9am PT, US east 10am ET, EMEA 10:30 GMT. can we bake that into the routing matrix? :mailbox_with_mail:
Alex: yes. here's the quick routing matrix I'm thinking (proto):
```
segment: enterprise-active -> email: webinar-invite, send_windows: [10ET], CTA: register -> followup: calendar + recording
segment: trial-high-usage -> email: webinar-invite + product-worksheet, send_windows: [9PT,10ET]
segment: newsletter-only -> email: benchmark-brief -> followup: deep-dive -> last: webinar-invite (soft)
segment: dormant-users -> reengage series + opt-down option
```
Maya: love the matrix. small ask: add an 'industry' branch for vertical hooks (infra, search, agent-apps). personalize one line in subject.
CJ: subject test ideas: A) "New benchmark: 2–3x inference cost drop — see results" B) "Benchmark + webinar: how we cut inference cost" — run 50/50 on enterprise and trial segments.
Zara: preheaders: keep short. draft: "Live webinar + actionable configs" vs "See the full benchmark + register". I'll prep variants.
Sam: tracking notes — use UTM campaign = benchmark_q2_launch, utm_content = {subject_variant}, utm_medium=email. set conv event for webinar_reg and benchmark_download. include hidden seed list for deliverability checks.
Alex: good call. also want to gate the webinar invite for small teams after they click benchmark_download (so organic readers don't all flood the webinar). rule: newsletter-only get invite only if clicked benchmark_download OR opened both emails in the series.
Maya: cadence question — do we push a last-chance reminder 24h before the webinar only to those with >1 engagement? want to avoid over-emailing.
CJ: yes send last-chance only to engaged (click/open >1). include one-off SMS opt-in for trial accounts who consented.
Zara: creative ask — can we add a 20–30s hero clip (mp4) inside the second email? Outlook might break autoplay but link to host. We'll include a fallback image with play button.
Sam: FYI, for large sends we should chunk by 10k/hour and monitor bounces + spam complaints. add pause point after each chunk for rapid rollback.
Alex: timeline: draft content by Thu EOD, subject/preheaders by Fri morning, seed send + small proof on Fri noon, full roll Monday for early cohorts, main blast Tue 10ET.
Maya: I'll take subject + preheaders, and set up the 50/50 A/B.
CJ: I'll author the routing rules in the sheet and export CSV for ops. link to sheet when done.
Zara: I'll hand off creative + hero clip Wednesday.
Sam: I'll configure tracking, seed list, and the chunked send script. will add monitoring dashboard in Console -> routes -> benchmark-q2.
Alex: Awesome — last thing: include a short benchmark narrative blurb in the email top (one sentence, outcomes-first) so readers get the TL;DR before they scroll. Draft example: "Our Q2 benchmark shows a 2.4x median cost reduction across common prompt shapes — join our webinar to see configs and quantized models that deliver it."
Maya: that line works. I'll test shorter version for subject mapping.
Alex: Perfect. I'll update the matrix and post the sheet link here when ready. :rocket:
